name: eol-time
description: Log hours (with an optional task type), log a whole day in one message, run your timer, submit your week, log expenses and work the approval queue in EOL Time (time.eol.agency, EOL's Harvest replacement) from Claude. Optional, off by default: record when you work in Claude Code (times and folder names only) and sort it into your timesheet later. The EOL Time MCP server, seven skills and the capture hooks.

api_key.title: EOL Time API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://time.eol.agency/settings/api-keys. A key starting eol_time_ can only track and submit your own time (recommended); one starting eol_full_ can do everything you can in EOL Time, which expenses and approvals need.
